expectations.text: Avoids commodity language and vendor positioning
expectations.evidence: Explicitly rejects 'deliver X renders' vendor language; replaces with 'strategic visualization system', 'decision moments', 'narrative structure'; eliminates price-per-image framing.

expectations.text: Connects to business outcome (sales, decisions, risk, alignment)
expectations.evidence: Corrected email anchors on 'secure stakeholder alignment / accelerate pre-sales / validate design before construction / present to investors'; frames $6,200 as investment in decision-making capability.

expectations.text: Positions Rendimension as strategic partner, not vendor
expectations.evidence: Reframed from deliverables to outcomes; establishes Rendimension's authority by asking qualifying questions instead of chasing business; tone shifts from 'here's what we deliver' to 'here's what we need to confirm'.

Email opens with client's business objective, not with render count; pricing presented as investment in solving problem, not as production cost; strategic mechanism (visuals) introduced after outcome framing.

expectations.text: Would pass Hugo's review without edits
expectations.evidence: Explicitly noted: 'This version passes all five levels and would pass the Hugo Test'; protects premium positioning and maintains professional, structured tone required by Rendimension's brand.
